title: Al-'Adl bayna al-Abna' wa Atharuhu fi Tarbiyatihim

text_simplified: Parents must treat their children with justice in gifts, wealth, and love, because favoring one over another plants hatred and jealousy. The story of al-Nu'man ibn Bashir teaches us that the Prophet ﷺ commanded justice among children even in a kiss. Parents should bring their children closer to one another and plant respect and love between them. It is also important to focus on teaching girls the Qur'an in suitable *hifz* (memorization) schools.

review_defects.arabic: العدل بين الأبناء وأثره في تربيتهم
review_defects.english: Al-'Adl bayna al-Abna' wa Atharuhu fi Tarbiyatihim
review_defects.why: The Arabic title is a descriptive phrase meaning 'Justice between children and its effect on their upbringing,' but the English title is only a transliteration, so the meaning is not conveyed to an English reader.
